ageGateBody: AI feedback is only for accounts marked 18 or older (same gate as Feldman feedback). Under 18: use checklists and sentence frames.
disclaimer: For self-review only — formative guidance, not an official SBA / HKEAA mark. AI does not award marks, edit your image, or give grades or scores.
emptyState: Upload evidence first, then tap for feedback (it never runs automatically).
errorGeneric: Couldn’t get feedback. Try again later.
tipUseOwnWords: If you use AI elsewhere in your writing, you must declare it.
